blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The 2026-27 NBA season continued November 19 (November 18 in the US), with a 12-game slate featuring several streak-busting performances. The 76ers overcame a 17-point deficit, the Heat claimed their sixth straight win, and the Jazz stunned the Lakers to end their nine-game run. Philadelphia 76ers beat Orlando Magic, 121-116 Joel Embiid scored 26 points, while VJ Edgecombe added a season-high 24, including 13 in the fourth quarter.
